title.zh: 宣布每年 2 月第一周为全国“世界宗教间和谐”周，并要求各政府机构遵行的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring the First Week of February of Every Year as "World Interfaith Harmony" Week" in the Entire Country and Mandating its Observance By the Different Government Agencies
title.orig: An Act Declaring the First Week of February of Every Year as "World Interfaith Harmony" Week" in the Entire Country and Mandating its Observance By the Different Government Agencies

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2013/ra_10525_2013.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The first week of February of every year is declared as "World Interfaith Harmony Week" in the entire country. All government agencies and instrumentalities, including government-owned and -controlled corporations as well as local government units, are hereby mandated to carry out the observance of activities designed to advance the message of interfaith harmony and goodwill in accordance with religious traditions and practices.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication m the Official Gazette or in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
